interpretation: The current recovery-card prompt performed strongly on these short, explicit cases.

The one observed omission compressed an open question into a generic reference and lost the exact alternatives, illustrating that operationally relevant detail can disappear even before repeated drift accumulates.

No case exercised enough compaction depth or ambiguity to reproduce the reported long-horizon telephone effect; later evaluation should include a longer adversarial trajectory rather than treating this score as evidence that recursive cards are sufficient.
